<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">mixed</span> <span class="hl-var">$payload</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">mixed</span> <span class="hl-var">$value</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">mixed</span> <span class="hl-var">$dup</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$listOf</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$nullFirst</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$allNull</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">mixed</span> <span class="hl-var">$nestedAny</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$plain</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            payload: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'payload'</span>],
            value: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'value'</span>],
            dup: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'dup'</span>],
            listOf: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'listOf'</span>],
            nullFirst: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'nullFirst'</span>],
            allNull: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'allNull'</span>],
            nestedAny: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'nestedAny'</span>],
            plain: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'plain'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'payload'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;payload,
            <span class="hl-str">'value'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;value,
            <span class="hl-str">'dup'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;dup,
            <span class="hl-str">'listOf'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;listOf,
            <span class="hl-str">'nullFirst'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;nullFirst,
            <span class="hl-str">'allNull'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;allNull,
            <span class="hl-str">'nestedAny'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;nestedAny,
            <span class="hl-str">'plain'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;plain,
        ];
    }
}
